Title: Director of Retention Marketing
Description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.

We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
* **Customer experience and support:** lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
* **Retention data and reporting:** track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final Interview with our CEO

**Salary Expectation**

USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

HSE requirements, and all applicable Qatari laws and regulations.

standards, including but not limited to Project Execution Plans, Risk Management Plans,

Statements, including a Work Breakdown Structure and resource plan, in line with

KAHRAMAA requirements.

tracked and reported through weekly and monthly updates (including S-curves, histograms, and look-ahead schedules).

frameworks and utility infrastructure, including metering projects.

communication.

Title: Director, Portfolio Management
Description:
**Location** Mississauga, Ontario, Canada **Job ID** R-264521 **Date posted** 16/11/2026

  

**WHY JOIN US?**

At AstraZeneca, we are dedicated to being a Great Place to Work, where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. With an ambitious goal of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, there is no better place to make a difference in medicine, for patients, and in society.

Join us on this exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare. Our inclusive culture champions diversity and collaboration, and we are always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. As part of our team, you'll contribute to groundbreaking advancements that will shape a healthier future for people everywhere. Be a catalyst for change at AstraZeneca, where your work will have a real impact on improving people's lives.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to create a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by **engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week**. Our head office is purposely designed with collaboration in mind, providing space where teams can come together to strategize, brainstorm and connect on key projects.

**About AISI**

AstraZeneca AI for Science Innovation (AISI) is driving the convergence of artificial intelligence and life sciences at enterprise scale. AISI brings together data foundations, AI and machine-learning technology, strategic partnerships, process reinvention, and business-facing AI to accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery. Success depends on connecting and scaling existing capabilities, promoting reuse, and translating innovation into measurable scientific, patient, and enterprise value.

**The Opportunity**

The Director, Portfolio Management will lead the design, governance, and continuous improvement of AISI's portfolio management capability across strategic initiatives, AI and data platforms, external partnerships, projects, suppliers, managed services, and operational investments. The role ensures that strategy is translated into an executable portfolio, investments and resources are directed to the highest-value opportunities, delivery performance is transparent, and financial and operational risk, and compliance governance are embedded throughout the portfolio lifecycle.

Operating at the intersection of AISI leadership, scientific and therapeutic-area stakeholders, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, HR, and external partners, the Director will establish scalable ways of working, strengthen evidence-based decision-making, and deliver outcomes through cross-functional teams and managed-service providers. The role sits within AISI Operations and reports to the Head of AISI Operations.

**Scope and Core Accountabilities**

**Portfolio Strategy, Planning, and Governance**
------------------------------------------------

* Translate AISI strategy and scientific priorities into an integrated portfolio of investments, initiatives, platforms, products, partnerships, and operational services.
* Establish and continuously improve demand intake, assessment, value-based prioritization, funding, resource allocation, stage-gate review, delivery assurance, and benefits-realization processes.
* Maintain an integrated portfolio view, identifying opportunities to stop, sequence, accelerate, consolidate, reuse, or scale initiatives as priorities and evidence evolve.
* Lead portfolio governance forums and provide clear executive reporting on investment, demand, delivery health, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, capacity, financial performance, and expected value.
* Develop standardized dashboards and management information that enable timely, transparent, evidence-based decisions without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

**Financial and Investment Management**
---------------------------------------

* Partner with Finance and senior leaders to manage long-term investment planning, business cases, budgets, forecasts, and Run and Change expenditure.
* Oversee forecast-versus-budget analysis, variance management, accruals, cross-charges, resource recharges, purchase orders, and supplier-related financial commitments.
* Ensure financial information is accurate, timely, transparent, and connected to portfolio priorities, delivery milestones, and benefits realization.
* Define and track financial and non-financial value measures, including scientific impact, speed, adoption, reuse, risk reduction, productivity, and enterprise scalability.

**Operating Model and Process Excellence**
------------------------------------------

* Design and evolve the portfolio operating model, decision rights, governance forums, escalation pathways, and RACI frameworks required to manage a complex, global portfolio.
* Drive standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across portfolio, project, financial, supplier, contracting, resource, onboarding, and service-management processes.
* Introduce fit-for-purpose Agile, Lean Portfolio Management, Design Thinking, incremental delivery, and hybrid governance practices where appropriate.
* Ensure processes are practical, adopted, and supported by reliable data and fit-for-purpose tools, including ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, and portfolio or financial-management platforms.

**Partnership, Contracting, and Supplier Governance**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Provide end-to-end portfolio oversight of strategic alliances, AI and data partnerships, technology providers, suppliers, and managed services.
* Partner with Legal, Procurement, Finance, Privacy, Information Security, and technical leaders across the contracting lifecycle, from intake, due diligence, term-sheet development, and negotiation through execution, performance review, renewal, and exit.
* Implement supplier and partner governance through scorecards, service-level agreements, periodic business reviews, delivery-quality measures, commercial-health monitoring, risk mitigation, and value-for-money assessments.
* Ensure partner commitments, dependencies, milestones, financial obligations, and benefits are integrated into portfolio planning and reporting.

**Resource and Capacity Management**
------------------------------------

* Lead resource and capacity-management practices across projects, products, platforms, partnerships, and operational services.
* Oversee workforce planning, allocation, utilization, people recharges, onboarding, and prioritization of scarce scientific, AI, engineering, and portfolio-management capabilities.
* Work with functional leaders to identify capability gaps, resolve constraints, improve onboarding, and align internal and external capacity with strategic priorities.

**Risk, Compliance, and Delivery Assurance**
--------------------------------------------

* Establish portfolio-level approaches to risk, issue, dependency, assumption, and decision management, ensuring material concerns are identified early, escalated appropriately, and managed through resolution.
* Provide oversight of scope, schedule, cost, quality, benefits, adoption, operational readiness, and delivery performance across the portfolio.
* Ensure portfolio activities and external arrangements comply with relevant pharmaceutical and technology requirements, including data governance, GDPR and privacy, information security, intellectual property, procurement, ethical, quality, and regulatory frameworks.
* Anticipate and manage delivery underperformance, supplier failure, commercial disputes, IP complexity, changing priorities, financial pressure, data and technology dependencies, and regulatory constraints.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Change Enablement**
------------------------------------------------

* Build trusted relationships with AISI and Enterprise AI leaders, therapeutic and scientific areas, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Legal, HR, Operations, and external partners.
* Facilitate alignment on priorities, investment choices, delivery expectations, trade-offs, and accountabilities across a global matrix organization.
* Communicate complex portfolio, financial, commercial, and delivery matters clearly to senior leaders and diverse stakeholder groups.
* Champion adoption of portfolio standards, transparent governance, and collaborative delivery while preserving the speed and experimentation required for AI innovation.

**Leadership**
--------------

* Lead and develop high-performing portfolio management, governance, and business-operations capabilities, directly and through matrix teams and managed-service providers.
* Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, continuous improvement, reuse, and measurable value delivery.
* Set clear standards and build scalable capabilities from the ground up, enabling consistent ways of working across functions and geographies.
* Contribute to AISI functional strategy and operating model evolution as the organization, technology landscape, and partnership ecosystem mature.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Essential**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, finance, life sciences, project management, law, data science, or a related discipline; a Master's degree or equivalent extensive professional experience is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience across portfolio management, program or project management, business operations, financial management, alliance or partnership management, supplier governance, contracting, or a related discipline in a complex global organization.
* Demonstrated experience leading portfolio management and process-transformation initiatives, including demand intake, value-based prioritization, governance, investment planning, resource allocation, delivery assurance, and benefits realization.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, long-term planning, investment tracking, forecasting, budget management, accruals, variance analysis, cross-charges, purchase orders, and resource recharges.
* Experience managing suppliers, strategic partners, external collaborations, or managed services, including contracts, service levels, performance, commercial risk, value for money, and issue resolution.
* Experience designing and implementing operating models, decision rights, governance forums, processes, RACI frameworks, dashboards, and management information.
* Proven success influencing senior leaders and delivering through cross-functional teams, matrix structures, third parties, and managed-service providers.
* Ability to operate with limited direction in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and make sound decisions that balance scientific and strategic value, risk, cost, capacity, compliance, and delivery feasibility.
* Exceptional written, verbal, influencing, relationship management, and organizational skills.

**Desirable**
-------------

* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, life sciences, or another highly regulated technology environment.
* Working knowledge of AI and machine-learning ecosystems, data partnerships, cloud platforms, digital products, technology platforms, and platform-based delivery models.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical research and development and how AI, data, platforms, and external partnerships create scientific and competitive advantage.
* Experience establishing or scaling portfolio management, alliance management, PMO, or business-operations function.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Waterfall, Design Thinking, or hybrid delivery approaches.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, and comparable portfolio, project, financial, procurement, or service-management tools.
* Knowledge of data governance, privacy, information security, intellectual property, quality, regulatory compliance, and IT risk management.
* Professional qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent portfolio, program, commercial, or supplier-management credentials.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* **Strategic thinking:** Connects scientific and enterprise strategy to investment choices, delivery priorities, and measurable value.
* **Enterprise perspective:** Optimizes across the portfolio, promotes reuse and scalability, and avoids isolated solutions.
* **Execution discipline:** Establishes clear governance and follows through to achieve reliable delivery and benefits realization.
* **Commercial and financial judgment:** Balances value, cost, risk, contractual obligations, compliance, and capacity.

MWH Constructors, a global leader in construction of water and wastewater facilities, is currently seeking a Quality Manager to support projects on our Southern Nevada Water Authority (SNWA) projects. The Quality Manager is responsible for developing and implementing our Quality Management System (QMS) and will be a steadfast advocate for continuous improvement to the QMS which further complements our overall growth and risk mana

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities**
------------------------------------------

The Quality Manager is responsible for overseeing and implementing quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) programs for the mechanical, electrical, and process systems associated with an operational water treatment facility. This position ensures construction activities, materials, equipment, and workmanship meet project specifications, applicable codes, regulatory requirements, and MWH quality standards.

Reporting to the MWH Quality Director and the assigned Project Manager, this field-based position works closely with project leadership, construction teams, subcontractors, engineers, and clients to promote quality, resolve technical challenges, and drive continuous improvement.

### **Quality Management & Compliance**

* Lead and oversee daily QA/QC activities for mechanical, electrical, and process-related construction work at an operational water treatment facility.
* Implement, maintain, and monitor the project-specific Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with contractual requirements, construction specifications, applicable codes, and industry standards.
* Supervise and support onsite quality personnel, ensuring inspections, documentation, and quality control activities are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Partner with project management, subcontractors, and self-perform construction teams to develop, implement, and maintain project-specific quality plans.
* Manage and enforce the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Three-Phase Control System, including preparatory, initial, and follow-up inspections and meetings.
* Ensure quality requirements, inspection checkpoints, and mandatory hold points are incorporated into construction work plans and schedules.

### **Inspections & Quality Control**

* Oversee inspections of construction activities, workmanship, materials, and equipment to verify compliance with approved plans, specifications, and quality standards.
* Ensure incoming materials and equipment are properly inspected, documented, handled, and stored in accordance with project requirements.
* Identify, document, and coordinate the resolution of quality deficiencies, nonconforming work, and recurring construction issues.
* Collaborate with engineering and construction teams to troubleshoot technical challenges, address constructability concerns, and develop practical solutions that maintain project quality and compliance.
* Provide technical guidance regarding applicable construction codes, industry standards, project specifications, and regulatory requirements.

### **Quality Documentation, Auditing & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and implement project quality audit plans to evaluate compliance, identify risks, and support continuous improvement.
* Monitor, analyze, and report quality-related Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including inspection results, deficiencies, recurring issues, and corrective actions.
* Implement and support Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) for managing quality inspections, documentation, reporting, and project controls.
* Ensure quality records, inspection reports, and supporting documentation are accurate, complete, organized, and maintained throughout the project.
* Identify opportunities to improve construction quality, reduce rework, and increase operational efficiency.
* Communicate lessons learned and quality improvement recommendations across project teams and the organization.

### **Team Leadership, Training & Development**

* Provide leadership, coaching, and technical guidance to onsite quality personnel, subcontractors, and construction teams.
* Coordinate initial project quality training to ensure personnel understand project requirements, inspection procedures, documentation expectations, and quality standards.
* Mentor subcontractor quality control personnel and promote consistent quality practices across all project participants.
* Support project teams in identifying quality trends, preventing recurring deficiencies, and implementing effective corrective actions.
* Promote a proactive quality culture by encouraging accountability, recognizing strong performance, and reinforcing the importance of delivering work correctly the first time.

### **Project Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Establish and maintain productive working relationships with project owners, clients, subcontractors, design partners, and other key stakeholders.
* Collaborate with project leadership to address quality concerns, resolve issues, and maintain alignment with client expectations.
* Support the development of Project Management Plans (PMPs), including quality procedures, documentation systems, and project startup requirements.
* Coordinate quality-related project kickoff activities, training, and partnering initiatives.
* Communicate quality performance, potential risks, and improvement opportunities to project leadership and clients.
* Support business development and proposal efforts by providing input on quality requirements, anticipated quality-related costs, and contractual risks.

### **Quality Leadership & Accountability**

* Serve as a visible advocate for MWH's commitment to construction excellence, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
* Promote a culture in which quality is integrated into planning, construction execution, and project delivery.
* Recognize and reinforce positive quality practices while encouraging proactive identification and resolution of potential issues.
* Work collaboratively with project teams to deliver high-quality construction that meets contractual obligations and client expectations.

Allied Universal is looking to hire a Security Assistant Account Manager. Responsible for supervising, motivating, coaching and training Also responsible for evaluating the work performance of Security Professionals and making recommendations regarding assignments
* Responsible for making sure that Post Order manual and all other post and training information is being properly maintained and updated, and that the Post is being properly maintained, cleaned and organized

Demonstration of strong customer service orientation required, with ability to effectively resolve client issues in a professional and service-focused manner and to de-escalate situations before they become hostile or unpleasant required
* Professional, articulate and able to use good independent judgment and discretion
* Ability to train and coach others, and to effectively enforce post orders, security standards and company policies equitably and consistently
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills required. Ability to successfully interact at all levels of the organization, including with clients, while functioning as a team player required
* Incumbent must be available to work outside normal shift schedule on an as-needed basis, and must be accessible by phone or pager 24/7 for emergency response

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing
Description:
We seek an individual inspired by our mission, whose beliefs align with our core values of integrity, inquiry, compassion and courage, and who reflects our core competencies to join our Upper School as **Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing** beginning in August 2027. This is a full-time position.

Salary range: $124,000 to $165,000. The total compensation for this Assistant Head position is based on placement on the Havergal College faculty grid plus a $20,000 leadership stipend (included in the above salary range). Grid placement is determined by teaching qualifications and experience up to a maximum of 11 years. Final placement within the range is based on the successful candidate's credentials and years of experience.

**Why Teach with Us**

At Havergal College, we believe that our strength lies in our faculty and staff's collective efforts, talents, and accomplishments. Together, we can make a positive and lasting impact on our students' lives.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package for teachers, including a faculty teaching grid that is well above the major urban school boards; contributions to and participation in the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan and/or Group RSP; generous holidays that allow employees to recharge; comprehensive health and dental benefits; support for professional development including support for graduate work, additional qualifications (AQs), faculty-wide and individual professional development in teaching and learning, wellbeing, equity and inclusion, assessment, and experiential education; and teaching on a beautiful 22-acre campus with excellent facilities.

**Why Havergal is the Place to Be**

Founded in 1894 and located on a beautiful 22-acre campus in midtown Toronto, Canada, Havergal College is one of Canada’s pre-eminent independent schools for girls from Junior Kindergarten through Grade 12.

At Havergal College, we believe great schools are made up of great people. With a rich history spanning over 130 years, we are committed to offering a contemporary liberal arts education rooted in the Anglican tradition. Our mission is to prepare young women to make a difference. Through our outstanding academic and co-curricular programs and a cohesive, collegial team of faculty and administrative staff, we nurture a culture of capability that fosters self-confidence, leadership, critical thinking, and global-mindedness in our students.

We take pride in attracting and retaining highly qualified faculty and administrative staff to ensure our school remains at the forefront of educational excellence. Join us in this transformative education journey, working together to empower young women to make a positive difference in our world.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that an inclusive environment fosters a culture of mutual respect, creativity and innovation, collaboration and accountability. To this end, we encourage applications from all qualified candidates with diverse experiences and perspectives, including women, BIPOC (Black, Indigenous and People of Colour) peoples, LGBTQ2S+, and persons with disabilities to join our thriving team. We seek candidates committed to nurturing a community where integrity, compassion, inquiry and courage thrive.

**The Position:**

The Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing provides operational leadership for student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12. Working collaboratively with the Upper School Leadership Team, this role ensures that every student is known, valued, and cared for, and has access to the relationships, resources, and support necessary to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing oversees the integrated work of Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role. Through the leadership and development of these teams, the Assistant Head establishes a coordinated and responsive approach to student support that promotes belonging, engagement, inclusion and student success.

Guided by Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing, the Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing leads proactive and preventative approaches to wellbeing across the Upper School, building the capacity of faculty and staff to support students and ensuring effective systems are in place to identify and respond to emerging student needs.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing reports directly to the Head of Upper School and is accountable for fostering a safe, equitable and inclusive school culture aligned with Havergal's mission and values. This is a faculty leadership position requiring teaching qualifications and experience in an educational setting.

**Specific Accountabilities:**

**Leadership of Student Support & Wellbeing**

* Lead the development, implementation and ongoing evaluation of a comprehensive, coordinated approach to student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12, aligned with Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing.
* Champion proactive, preventative, strengths-based and evidence-informed approaches to wellbeing that promote student belonging, resilience, engagement and healthy development.
* Identify emerging trends in student wellbeing and learning needs, using relevant data, research and professional expertise to inform priorities, programming and resource allocation.
* Partner with the Assistant Heads of Middle and Senior Divisions and the Director of Boarding to ensure that wellbeing priorities are meaningfully embedded in the student experience, including Form, Teacher Advisor, grade-level and Boarding programming.
* Build faculty and staff capacity through professional learning and shared practices that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive education and effective responses to student needs.
* Contribute to school-wide strategic initiatives that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive excellence and the overall student experience.

**Leadership and Oversight of Student Support Services**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role.
* Lead, coach and develop Student Support leaders and team members, fostering professional growth, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities and communication practices across Student Support services to ensure an integrated and effective approach to student care.
* Oversee the effective allocation of staffing, resources and budgets across Student Support services.
* Ensure the effective delivery and continuous improvement of student support services, promoting responsive, accessible and coordinated support that meets the evolving needs of students and families.
* Provide leadership for Learning Support practices, ensuring effective systems for accommodations, Individual Education Plans and appropriate academic interventions.
* Champion the development of executive functioning skills, learning strategies and student self-advocacy in collaboration with academic leaders and faculty.
* Promote effective transitions for students entering, moving through and graduating from the Upper School, with particular attention to students requiring additional support.

**Coordinated Student Care and Intervention**

* Lead the development and implementation of effective systems for identifying, assessing, supporting and monitoring students experiencing academic, social, emotional, behavioural or health-related challenges.
* Oversee the Upper School Student Support Team, ensuring effective multidisciplinary collaboration, clear processes for case management and appropriate follow-through.
* Establish consistent protocols for student referrals, documentation, communication, intervention planning and escalation of concerns.
* Provide leadership and consultation in complex student support matters, working closely with Student Support professionals, divisional Assistant Heads and the Head of Upper School.
* Ensure that student support planning reflects appropriate professional expertise, confidentiality, safeguarding responsibilities and relevant school policies.
* Partner with families and external professionals, as appropriate, to coordinate student care and support successful school engagement.
* Oversee processes for student re-entry and reintegration following health-related leaves or other circumstances requiring coordinated support.

**Collaborative and Engaged Member of the Upper School Leadership Team**

* Serve as an active member of the Upper School Leadership Team, collaborating with divisional Assistant Heads, the Director of Boarding, Academic Leadership and Student Life leaders to advance shared priorities for student learning, wellbeing and engagement.
* Provide advice to the Head of Upper School on emerging student support needs, complex cases, resource priorities and opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to the ongoing review and development of relevant school policies, procedures, the Family Handbook and communications relating to student support and wellbeing.
* Support Admissions in reviewing prospective applicants with IEPs or social-emotional needs.

**Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience**

* A recognized teaching qualification and membership in good standing with the Ontario College of Teachers (OCT), or equivalent qualifications and eligibility for OCT certification.
* Demonstrated teaching experience in a school setting, preferably with students in Grades 7–12.
* Experience in educational leadership, student support, Guidance, Learning Support or a related area of school-based practice.
* Deep understanding of the developmental, academic, social and emotional needs of students in Grades 7–12.
* Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary approaches to student wellbeing, mental health promotion, inclusive education and coordinated student support.
* Familiarity with the priorities and contemporary approaches within a girls' school.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary teams and foster a collaborative, accountable team culture.
* Sound professional judgement, discretion and problem-solving ability, particularly in navigating complex and sensitive student and family matters.
* Strong understanding of safeguarding, confidentiality, professional boundaries and appropriate student support and intervention practices.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships, think strategically and manage competing priorities.
* Leadership qualifications are an asset.
* Demonstrated ability and commitment to the Core & Leadership Competencies of:
  + Inclusive Excellence
  + Collaboration & Teamwork
  + Integrity & Trust
  + Learning Agility
  + Communication
  + Growth Mindset
  + Coach & Develop Others
  + Managerial Courage
  + Champion Change & Innovation

Title: Assistant Director of Resident Care – IPAC Lead
Description:
**Main Duties:**

**Ensure and Promote Resident-Centred Care**

Provision of resident-driven nursing and personal support care and services are available to meet the needs of the residents as follows:

* Promote the philosophy and practices of resident-centered care
* Support a resident advocacy program through promotion and respect of the Residents’ Bill of Rights.
* Support quality resident care experiences to achieve their physical, social, emotional well-being.
* Facilitate relationship among residents and family members, staff, volunteers and community.
* Ensure a comfortable and safe environment that promotes residents’ privacy, dignity and individuality.

**Provide Leadership for Nursing and Personal Support Care**

* Set annual departmental goals and objectives that are congruent with the mission of the Home
* Set, monitor and improve standards of Nursing and Personal Support Care Services to meet the requirement of the Fixing Long Term Care Act.
* Participate in strategic planning of the Home and interdisciplinary care team.
* Develop and ensure implementation of policies and procedures of Nursing and Personal Support Care Services
* Ensure required resources (human, fiscal and material) are available and quality is meeting the resident care needs.
* Participate as a lead /member of Quality Management Committee.
* Collaborate with Administrator, medical staff , Director of Care and other health care disciplines and services to meet the residents’ health care needs.
* Work in collaboration with team members to liaise with Ontario Health at Home reviewing and approving applications for placement.
* Network with other long term care facilities, community services and educational organizations in establishing community partnership.
* Support and participate in the education and research programs conducted by the Home and other professional agencies.

**Act as Infection Prevention and Control Lead**

* Working with the interdisciplinary team to implement the infection prevention and control program.
* Managing and overseeing the infection prevention and control program.
* Overseeing the delivery of infection prevention and control education to all staff, caregivers, volunteers, visitors and residents.
* Auditing of infection prevention and control practices in the home.
* Conducting regular infectious disease surveillance.
* Convening the Outbreak Management Team at the outset of an outbreak and regularly throughout an outbreak.
* Convening the interdisciplinary infection prevention and control team referred to in subsection (4) at least quarterly, and at a more frequent interval during an infectious disease outbreak in the home.
* Reviewing the information gathered pursuant to subsection (9).
* Reviewing any daily and monthly screening results collected by the licensee to determine whether any action is required.
* Implementing required improvements to the infection prevention and control program as required by audits under paragraph 4 or by the licensee.
* Ensuring that there is in place a hand hygiene program in accordance with any standard or protocol issued by the Director under subsection (2) which includes, at a minimum, access to hand hygiene agents at point-of-care.

**Provide Effective Professional Nursing and Personal Care Practice**

* Lead, supervise, delegate clinical responsibilities to appropriately qualified staff to effectively manage all clinical core programs stated in the Fixing Long Term Care Act.
* Communicate and lead the multidisciplinary care team and disperse relevant information.
* Enforce medication management standards and ensure medication administration safety.

**Provide Effective Human Resource Practices**

* Develop a staffing plan which provides a staffing mix that is consistent with residents’ assessed care and safety needs.
* Develop, implement and monitor nursing and personal care workers personnel policies and procedures, including position descriptions.
* Responsible for departmental recruitment process and retention of nursing personnel.
* Develop and coordinate nursing staff schedules.
* Conduct probation and annual performance appraisal of all nursing staff.
* Effectively making use of educational resources including RNAO best practice guidelines to plan and promote staff development program including orientation, in-service and continuing education as determined by the learning needs of nursing staff and maintenance of specific nursing skills.
* Ensure there is a process for employee conflict resolution and progressive disciplinary actions for those with performance issues.

**Promote and Ensure Occupational Health and Safety**

* Ensure nursing staff are provided with necessary instructions/orientation regarding measures and procedures to be taken.
* Ensure that all lost time accidents are investigated and recommendations of the Joint Health and Safety Committee are implemented.
* Arrange modified work programs for nursing staff and liaise with WSIB personnel as necessary.
* Select appropriate certified nursing staff as nursing representative in Joint Health and Safety Committee in promoting workplace safety.
* Conduct planned and unplanned inspection of the nursing areas, document and ensure unsafe conditions are corrected.

**Provide for Effective Use of Material Resources**

* Prepare and implement nursing budget plan and administer the approved budget of the Home
* Provide professional input regarding the need and use of equipment and supplies for resident care.
* Maintain efficient and effective inventory control.
* Review contracts and quality of purchased services.

**Maintain an Appropriate Recording System**

* Ensure that information obtained by nursing and personal care staff is available to the Resident Care Team, residents and families in a professional manner, consistent with facility policies and procedures for maintaining confidentiality of information and records.
* Develop, maintain and monitor resident-centred care plans and Resident Health Records are in accordance with the standards and guidelines of applicable legislations and the professional licensing organization
* Maintain nursing and personal care personnel records.

**Qualification:**

Reasonable efforts that will be used to ensure qualifications for the Assistant Director of Resident Care are as follows:

* Current certification in infection control from the Certification Board of Infection Control and Epidemiology or willingness to obtain the certification upon hire
* Registered Nurse with a current certificate of competence from the College of Nurses of Ontario.
* Current membership of Registered Nurses’ Association of Ontario (RNAO) is desirable.
* Possession of valid CPR (Health Care Provider Level C) and First Aid certificates
* 3 years relevant experience in a long term care facility including infection control, head nurse in chronic care or senior management in a health community agency.
* Professional core competences in clinical knowledge, assessment skills, communication skills, conflict management, organizational skills.
* Demonstrate commitment in continuous quality improvement, leadership, initiatives and team work.
* Post-RN education, certification or degree in nursing administration and health management is an asset,
* Experience and proficiency in using clinical software
* Proficiency in oral and written English.
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to speak Cantonese /Mandarin in addition to English is an asset.

Title: Customer Service Manager
Description:
**Who we are:**

In 1996, Farmers Depot was established and has grown to be the complete animal health and equipment supplier for livestock producers across Canada providing thousands of quality animal health products at a competitive price with next day delivery, and product support. Farmers Depot is under the GVF Group umbrella and operates in close affiliation with Grand Valley Fortifiers and Fortified Nutrition Limited. Both brands manufacture and sell high-quality, leading-edge vitamin and mineral premixes and supplements for swine, dairy, beef and poultry producers.

  

Today, the GVF Group is comprised of seven divisions: Grand Valley Fortifiers, Fortified Nutrition, Farmers Depot, Direct Source Commodities, Livestack, True Foods, and Kindred Farmers. Across all divisions, we are united by a common purpose – helping our customers achieve better results through innovation, partnership, and trusted advice.

  

Ours is a family business that cares about its employees and its community. We make sure that all our staff get what the best-in-class team members deserve: benefits, good wages, and respect. Whether through our charitable work, or our dedication to staff, GVF is committed to living out our principles and values.

  

**Why we have this role:**

  

At Farmers Depot, providing an exceptional customer experience is at the heart of what we do. We're looking for a **Customer Service Manager** who is passionate about building strong customer relationships, developing people and finding better ways to work.

  

In this role, you'll lead and support our Customer Service team, ensuring our customers receive timely, knowledgeable and reliable service. You'll play an important role in shaping the department's processes, setting performance expectations and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen customer relationships and support business growth.

  

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone who is comfortable leading from the front, coaching their team while also stepping into day-to-day customer service activities when needed. You'll take the time to understand our customers, systems and processes firsthand so you can effectively support the team and lead continuous improvement.

**Working with us:**

This is a permanent, full-time position based out of the Farmers Depot Head Office at 455 Dobbie Drive in Cambridge, Ontario.

Our Customer Service team serves customers Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:30pm. Your regular working hours will be Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break.

  

As the Customer Service Manager, you'll be responsible for ensuring the department is appropriately staffed and equipped to serve customers throughout core business hours. Occasional work outside standard hours, including weekends, may be required to meet business needs.

  

**What you’ll do:**

  

**Customer Service Leadership**

  

* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching and support to the Farmers Depot Customer Service team.
* Establish clear departmental objectives, performance expectations and accountability.
* Assess team structure, responsibilities, workflows and operational challenges to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build employee capabilities through coaching, training, ongoing feedback and development.
* Address performance concerns and support individual and team development.
* Establish consistent communication practices and team routines that encourage collaboration and accountability.
* Lead the implementation of new and revised processes, ensuring employees are trained and accountable for following established procedures.
* Take a hands-on, player-coach approach by actively supporting day-to-day Customer Service activities, including processing customer orders, responding to inquiries, resolving customer concerns and providing coverage during busy periods.
* Develop a strong understanding of departmental systems, processes and workflows to effectively support the team and identify opportunities to improve operations.

  

**Customer Experience & Performance**

  

* Champion an exceptional customer experience by ensuring customer inquiries and concerns are handled promptly and effectively.
* Identify recurring customer issues and implement corrective actions to prevent them from happening again.
* Establish and support consistent processes for managing escalated customer concerns.
* Work collaboratively with other departments to improve communication, coordination and the overall customer experience.
* Use operational data, KPIs and customer feedback to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service levels.
* Establish and monitor the administration of phone-based marketing and sales campaigns.
* Support cross-departmental managers and product teams in representing products and providing support to producers.

  

**Team Development & Continuous Improvement**

  

* Assess the current capabilities, responsibilities and development needs of the Customer Service team.
* Establish clear role expectations and responsibilities across the department.
* Identify training requirements and implement appropriate development plans.
* Develop processes, procedures and documentation that support consistent and effective departmental operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, communication, collaboration and sales growth.

  

**Your background includes:**

  

* Post-secondary education in Business Administration or a related field is preferred.
* At least 5 years of experience in a customer service role, providing direct customer support.
* At least 3 years of experience leading, coaching and mentoring a team.
* The ability to think strategically while remaining comfortable getting involved in day-to-day operations.
* Strong customer relationship skills and a professional, client-facing presence.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting and negotiation skills.
* The ability to manage competing priorities, multitask and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of customer service software, databases and tools; experience with Shopify is an asset.
* Technologically savvy with proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel.
* Experience in the agriculture industry is an asset.
* Fluency in both English and French is considered an asset.

  

**Why work with us:**

  

* Canadian Family-Owned and Operated Company
* Competitive wages
* Extended health and dental benefits
* RRSP matching program
* Profit sharing bonus
* Donation matching program
* Professional development opportunities
* Store discount at Valley Feeds
* Be part of a company that values integrity, innovation, and giving back.

  

**Living our values:**

We’re a family-owned business that values its people and the communities we serve. We are committed to providing a supportive and respectful workplace, offering competitive compensation and benefits, and investing in our employees’ success. Whether through our work with customers, our support of employees, or our community involvement, we strive to live our values every day.

  

* **Passion:** Serving customers innovatively and well.
* **Humble Confidence:** Confidently choosing to forgo our status, deploy our resources and use of influence for the good of others before ourselves.
* **Integrity:** Consistently honest while honouring commitments with our customers, co-workers and suppliers.
* **Professional:** Committed to excellence in the way we lead, serve and relate.
* **Caring:** With a servant heart, truly caring for customers and co-workers. Find satisfaction in assisting with others’ challenges and joy in witnessing their success.

  

All interested applicants are asked to apply with a copy of their resume. We thank all applicants for their interest however, only candidates considered for the position will be contacted for an interview.

Title: Operations Manager (Food Operations)
Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
The Operations Manager (Food Operations) owns end-to-end food delivery service quality across the platform, specifically driving ETA promise accuracy, minimizing lateness, and reducing order cancellations. Since most operational levers sit within partner teams (Logistics, Product, Commerce, and Supply), this role operates through rigorous data-driven diagnosis, cross-functional prioritization, and strategic influence rather than direct operational control. Leading a direct team of 6 compliance specialists, the Operations Manager translates high-level service quality targets into actionable initiative portfolios, robust supply-hour requirements, and sustainable marketplace growth.
  
  
**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
**Service Quality & KPI Ownership**

* Own the daily monitoring, weekly review, and detailed root-cause analysis of food delivery metrics across key drivers (prep time, handover timer, distance, zone dynamics, and supply levels).
* Maintain end-to-end accountability for stream targets, including order volume growth (OPU), Mashallah (perfect) order rate, on-time delivery, cancellation rate, and short-distance speed SLAs.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all cross-functional lateness, cancellation, and delivery quality issues.

**Initiative Portfolio & Pilot Management**

* Manage and execute the strategic initiative portfolio: adjust ETA promises, eliminate merchant/zone inefficiencies, speed up merchant dispatch, and tune courier product features.
* Size initiative impacts, assign functional owners, define explicit deadlines, and evaluate pilot results before granting go/no-go approval for full production rollout.
* Collaborate with the Vertical Profitability Manager to establish and enforce strict quality guardrails (TDT, contact rate, lateness, cancellations) for profitability initiatives such as order bundling.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment**

* Logistics & Product Alignment: Work with Logistics Algorithms and Product teams to adjust ETA/DPT accuracy, conduct elasticity tests, manage promotion-day promise adjustments, and enhance courier tools.
* Commerce & Merchant Quality: Partner with Commerce to reduce vendor prep and handover delays, adjust dispatch fitting for complex locations, and enforce merchant quality standards.
* Supply & Fleet Management: Translate service quality targets into precise supply-hour requirements for the Supply Team to drive full-timer (FT) courier acquisition and fleet capacity.

**Team Leadership & Direct Management**

* Directly manage, coach, and guide a direct team of 6 Compliance specialists based in Pakistan.
* Set clear individual performance targets, oversee daily audit workflows, and ensure team alignment with overarching platform quality goals.

**First 90 Days Roadmap & Execution**

* Day 30 (Diagnostics): Complete diagnostic mapping of lateness and cancellation drivers; build comprehensive KPI baselines and size/prioritize the initiative portfolio.
* Day 60 (Pilots): Launch 2–3 live pilots across Logistics, Product, and Commerce; establish weekly cross-functional governance cadences and finalize quality guardrails.
* Day 90 (Production Rollout): Evaluate pilots via go/no-go decisions, transition successful initiatives into production with defined owners and deadlines, and lock in long-term stream targets.

* Experience: 5+ years (or 3+ years for strong Middle candidate) in operations, logistics, or marketplace management within on-demand delivery, quick commerce, ride-hailing, or top-tier management consulting.
* Track Record: Proven record of measurably driving core operational metrics (on-time performance, cancellation reduction, ETA promise accuracy).
* Analytical Expertise: Strong capability in data analysis, dashboard building, root-cause investigation, and A/B test design/interpretation. Proficiency in SQL, Python, or Tableau/BI tools is highly advantageous.
* Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional cross-functional project coordination and communication skills; ability to deliver outcomes without direct hierarchical authority.
* Language & Location: Fluent English required. Readiness to relocate to Doha, Qatar. GCC market experience and Arabic language proficiency are strong advantages.

**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**
**Strategic Scope & Work Environment Requirements**

* Cross-Functional Influence & Leadership: Proven ability to drive outcomes across Logistics, Product, Commerce, and Supply teams without direct organizational authority.
* Data-Driven Problem Solving: Continuous monitoring, order-level analytics, and root-cause analysis to pinpoint inefficiencies across prep times, handover delays, zone quality, and dispatch algorithms.
* High-Tempo Execution: Agility to rapidly size initiative impacts, run cross-functional pilots, establish quality guardrails, and implement go/no-go decisions in a fast-growing marketplace environment.

Title: Hotel Manager - Hilton Salwa Beach Resort & Villas
Description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

A Hilton Hotel Manager is a hospitality leader, a brand ambassador, and a steward of Hilton’s legacy of delivering exceptional guest experiences. At the heart of every Hilton hotel is a commitment to warm, reliable, and hospitable service—and the Hotel Manager brings this to life through thoughtful leadership and operational excellence.

**About the Hilton Brand**

For nearly a century, Hilton Hotels & Resorts has been proudly welcoming the world’s travellers. With more than 584 hotels across six continents, Hilton Hotels & Resorts provides the foundation for exceptional travel experiences and values every guest who walks through its doors. The most recognised name in the industry, Hilton remains synonymous with the word ‘hotel’. From inaugural balls and Hollywood award galas to business events and days to remember, Hilton is where the world makes history, closes the deal, toasts special occasions, and gets away from it all. As the flagship brand of Hilton, Hilton Hotels & Resorts continues to set the standard for hospitality, providing new product innovations and services to meet guests’ evolving needs.

**About the Property**

One of the largest resorts in the Middle East, Hilton Salwa Beach Resort & Villas is an unparalleled destination offering world-class facilities and bespoke services for today’s luxury leisure travellers. Sprawling across 3.5 kms of prime coastline, the resort offers 361 rooms, including 84 beachfront villas, the largest water park in Qatar- Desert Falls Water and Adventure Park, more than 20 restaurants showcasing global flavours, a beach club, swimming pools, a marina, luxury spa and a health club.

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

As a **Hotel Manager** at a Hilton property, you’re not just leading hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Lead with Hilton’s commitment to exceptional hospitality:** Oversee all hotel operations to deliver warm, reliable, and hospitable service – ensuring every guest experience is seamless, consistent, and reflective of the brand’s high standards
* **Drive performance and profitability:** Manage revenue, budgets, and cost controls to achieve financial targets while balancing operational efficiency with innovative guest experiences
* **Oversee property priorities:** Lead capital projects, refurbishments, and service initiatives to maintain operational excellence and brand alignment
* **Set and execute strategic direction:** Shape short- and long-term goals, making decisions in the best interests of the hotel, the Hilton brand, and Hilton’s long-term vision
* **Inspire and develop talent:** Provide visionary leadership to the executive team and all Team Members, embedding Hilton’s values and fostering a team of passionate and creative professionals
* **Strengthen communication and collaboration:** Hold regular briefings with the Heads of Department (HOD) team and maintain strong relationships with owners, auditors, and Hilton stakeholders to ensure alignment and accountability
* **Commit to continuous improvement:** Uphold and exceed Hilton service standards, respond to audits proactively, and drive innovation and operational integrity across the business

  

**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader, with a strong focus on owner relations, commercial performance, and operational excellence. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

* An Established Director of Operations or Hotel Manager with strong operational experience in Rooms and/or F&B.
* Having strong international brand experience in a luxury resort environment is preferred.
* Extensive multi-cultural experience, adept at working with diverse teams and customers.
* Strong ability to collaborate and foster networks and relationships, with owners, contractors, corporates, and Tour Operators – must be highly visible.
* Demonstrable experience in delivering innovative commercial opportunities with experience in increasing profitability especially within Resorts.
* Dynamic and proactive approach with solid experience as an agent of change
* Exceptional people leadership and retention of talent with the ability to bring a team together on a journey and instilling the Hilton culture and values.
* Exceptional stakeholder/owner relations experience with demonstrable influencing skills.
* Ability to show resilience, judgement and leadership.
* Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar resort style property.
* Proven experience in delivering results with an eye for details and quality
* Experience in GCC/Qatar will be an advantage
* Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent.
* Fluency in English and Arabic required (spoken and written)

  

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Title: Hotel Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.

Step into a world of refined elegance and timeless artistry at Raffles Doha, an iconic address nestled within the architectural landmark of Katara Towers in Lusail.

Raffles Doha is where luxury becomes deeply personal — a place defined by quiet sophistication, meaningful moments, and the art of thoughtful service. Rooted in a legacy of gracious hospitality, Raffles is renowned for creating experiences that are intimate, bespoke, and unforgettable.

Here, every detail is considered, every interaction intentional, and every guest journey uniquely curated. Our colleagues are artisans of hospitality, empowered to anticipate needs, craft memories, and deliver service with elegance, discretion, and genuine care.

Joining Raffles Doha means becoming part of a storied brand where excellence is not an aspiration, but a standard — and where hospitality is expressed as an art form.

Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire.  **Job Description**

We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Raffles Doha as our new Hotel Manager.

The Hotel Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments, ensuring the delivery of exceptional luxury hospitality experiences in line with the standards and philosophy of Raffles Hotels & Resorts.

The role is responsible for driving operational excellence, financial performance, guest satisfaction, and colleague engagement while ensuring seamless coordination and alignment across all operational functions. Working closely with the Executive Committee and department heads, the Hotel Manager translates the hotel's strategic objectives into actionable business plans, strengthens operational efficiencies, and drives a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As a key member of the hotel's leadership team, the Hotel Manager acts as the Managing Director's principal operational partner, ensuring the effective execution of business strategies, safeguarding the hotel's reputation, and reinforcing Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury hospitality destination.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Managing Director to define and execute the hotel's strategic objectives and priorities
* Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments
* Drive operational excellence, revenue growth, profitability, and continuous improvement
* Monitor hotel performance and implement initiatives to enhance business results
* Ensure seamless operations and consistent delivery of Raffles brand standards
* Champion personalised luxury hospitality and exceptional guest experiences in line with Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards

* Lead and develop the Executive Committee and departmental leaders, fostering a high-performance culture
* Drive colleague engagement, talent development, and succession planning

* Oversee quality assurance, health and safety, security, and risk management

* Promote innovation, technology, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and guest experience
* Safeguard the hotel's reputation and strengthen Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury destination

  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field
* Minimum 10 years of experience in luxury hotel operations, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership position
* Proven track record within internationally recognised luxury hotel brands
* Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality standards, including Forbes Travel Guide, and LQA requirements
* Strong Food & Beverage experience across multiple outlets, with proven expertise in managing high-volume banquet operations
* Demonstrated success in driving operational excellence, financial performance, and guest satisfaction
* Strong commercial acumen and experience in budgeting, forecasting, and cost management
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop multicultural teams and senior leaders
* Excellent strategic thinking, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills
* Extensive knowledge of hotel operations, quality assurance, and service excellence
* Strong understanding of health, safety, security, and regulatory compliance
* Previous experience in the Middle East luxury hospitality market is preferred
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

  
**Additional Information**

**Employee Benefits**  
Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.

Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.

Title: Marketing Operations Manager
Description:
Deep Knowledge Group · MarTech Department · Reports to the Head of MarTech

**The role**
------------

Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech websites and platforms. Today the website tracking, the application analytics, the CRM and the campaign reports each work on their own. You will connect them: set up tracking, run the analytics and CRM systems, and make sure enquiries and reports reach the people who act on them.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Tracking and measurement**

* Create and run the company’s Google tag / GA4 account, install tags across Wix, custom-HTML and application sites, and remove the legacy tags that would double-fire.
* Verify sites in Search Console, submit sitemaps and keep reporting access working.
* Implement advertising pixels and conversion events with consent handling.
* Test that events actually arrive, with source, consent and duplicate checks, and keep a coverage record per site.

### **Analytics platform (PostHog)**

* Define a small shared event set, source and campaign fields, and how an anonymous visitor becomes a known contact.
* Run PostHog: projects, access, cost, identity handoff between domains, and event-based dashboards that update without manual spreadsheets.

### **CRM and automation (HubSpot)**

* Map form submissions, sources and outcomes into CRM contacts, with duplicate handling.
* Repair and maintain inbound email classification and routing, so every actionable enquiry reaches a named owner.
* Build audience segments with clear entry, exit and suppression rules, and run one follow-up workflow with the BisDev team.

### **Reporting and process**

* Keep dashboards labelled with data freshness and alert on collection failures.
* Document the setup so another person can run it: procedures, event definitions and a record of every automation and its owner.

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* Weeks 1–4: take over the new Google tag account, verify the priority sites in Search Console, and record a baseline of what tracks and what doesn’t.
* Weeks 5–8: agree the event and identity rules, and install tracking on the pilot sites in a way that survives page changes.
* Weeks 9–13: connect forms to the CRM, fix enquiry routing, and publish the first automatically updated dashboard.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, marketing analytics or a similar hands-on role.
* Hands-on with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Search Console, including consent and debugging.
* Experience with a CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot (we also have Zoho in use), including forms, workflows and routing.
* Experience with an event analytics tool such as PostHog, Mixpanel or Amplitude, including user identity.
* Comfortable reading page source and network requests to confirm that tracking works.
* You write clearly and document what you build.

### **Helpful**

* Experience with Wix and custom or application sites, and Cloudflare.
* Server-side tracking or conversion APIs.
* Basic SQL or scripting.
* Experience with GDPR or similar consent rules.
* Fluent Russian.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Web development: page templates, the scheduled checking worker and site fixes belong to a web engineer.
* Content and SEO writing, which belongs to the editor.
* Commercial follow-up, which BisDev owns. You build the routing and fields; they run the conversations.

**How you will work**
---------------------

You will work with the Head of MarTech, the web operations specialist (forms, publishing and web edits), the BisDev team, Front-end and Product. Tools include Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console, PostHog, HubSpot, Slack and Google Workspace. Working hours are flexible, with overlap with UK time (our team works roughly 8:00–18:00 UK).
