Title: SRO, Customer Excellence.
Description:
We are looking for a Senior Responsible Owner (SRO) for Customer Excellence to lead Echelon’s Customer Excellence Program and own the customer 360, our single view of each customer. You will set how AI agents and account teams work together, so that everyone who serves a customer works from the same, accurate picture.
  
  
****The role: one view of the customer****
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you own the customer 360 across our accounts. You work with the CRO’s account teams, the Head of AI Transformation and the deployment strategists, the engineers in the pods, and the leadership team. You bring partner insight into each customer’s view and work closely with the marketing and communications lead on customer engagements.
  
  
****What you’ll do****

* Build the customer 360. One record and one account plan per customer, kept current by AI agents and approved by the account owner: organization and decision makers, systems and data landscape, AI maturity, contracts, projects, pipeline, delivery history and value delivered.
* Own customer data. The quality of customer data in our CRM and delivery tools: what is captured, by whom and when, who can edit it, and how the account teams and pods use it.
* Read the customer. Each customer’s strategy, budgets, AI priorities, leadership changes and buying cycles, briefed to the account teams and strategists before key meetings.
* Measure customer health. Satisfaction and health measures across accounts, feedback after each engagement, and early warnings on accounts at risk.
* Run the cadence. The weekly presence on accounts: account reviews, executive touchpoints, customer events and programs, and their follow-up.
* Inform leadership. A regular customer review for the COO and the leadership team: where we win, where we lose, and what customers ask for that we do not yet deliver.

****What you bring****

* Customer record: 6+ years in customer success, account operations, CRM or customer analytics in a technology or services business.
* Data fluency: At ease with CRM systems, dashboards and imperfect data, and able to make them useful to others.
* Rigour: You keep records accurate and current without being asked, and build simple processes that last.
* Connector: You work across sales, delivery and leadership, and earn trust by being useful.
* AI fluency: You find use cases for AI and turn them into agentic workflows that serve the Customer Excellence Program end to end, and you decide where a person must review their work.

****Strong advantage****

* Sector knowledge: Experience with customers in a sector where Echelon leads, such as government, energy, financial services or healthcare.
* CRM platforms: Hands-on administration of a major CRM platform.
* Arabic: Professional fluency in Arabic.

****Our values****

* Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritize accordingly.
* Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* Builds others: You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

****How we work****
You start from the customer’s problem and choose the tool to fit it. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.
  
  

* Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves.
* Speed: You move from brief to a first working result quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* Rigour: You test claims against the data, check what is delivered and can explain every choice.
* Confidence and humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organize the work yourself.
* Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar organization: you find a way with what is available.
* Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* A force multiplier: Your playbooks, reviews and coaching make the whole bench faster.
* AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you research, write and decide. You are comfortable working alongside AI agents and setting the rules for when a person must approve their work.
* Who you are: An organized operator who loves customers and data in equal measure, and wants to build a function from the start.

****The seat****

* Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* Reports to: Chief Operating Officer
* Travel: Time at customer sites and events across the Kingdom
* Package: A base salary with housing, transport and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. Terms are shared at offer stage.

Title: Legal Counsel
Description:
Echelon contracts continuously: a portfolio of technology partners on structural, programme and referral agreements, MOUs and term sheets with defence and energy technology companies, customer Scopes of Work delivered by our forward deployed teams, and a share plan that reaches every employee.

We are looking for a qualified hands-on lawyer — admitted to practice, with the training that comes with it — who has drafted and negotiated the contracts behind technology and AI delivery services, understands how those businesses work, and has the head for it: one who would rather be the only counsel in the room than one of twenty. The legal function grows next year; you will have shaped how it works before it does.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.
* **Intellectual property:** Engineering IP held at group level, partner IP boundaries in every deployment, and the protection of Echelon-developed capability as it is productised.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**THE SEAT**
------------

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to candidates based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE  
**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the precedent. You meet an unclear brief or an unfamiliar instrument with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the business and its technology really work, and keep learning as the deals and the law move.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to workable draft quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You check before you rely, read every clause you put forward for signature and can explain every position you take.
* **Confidence & humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing documents, partial facts, an unfamiliar jurisdiction: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your templates, playbooks and clear guidance make every team you work with faster.
* **AI-native practice:** AI tools are part of how you research, draft and review, and you know where their output needs a lawyer’s check.

Title: Infrastructure Engineer TID
Description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 23,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

 **Job Description**

**Job Purpose:**

Under general supervision performs responsible professional engineering review, assessment, inspection, and administrative duties. This includes reviews of design- & construction- and development proposals related to all infrastructure projects (i.e., roads, highways, bridges, utilities of all kinds, etc.) and ensuring compliance with Qatar Rail requirements, asset protection and future safeguarding. Further advises interfacing parties on NOC requirements, conditions and required actions to obtain approvals.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

The **Infrastructure Engineer** will be responsible for the review of 3rd party applications in reference to Metro/ LRT/Long Distance project interfaces for the operational railways and future phases. The tasks will include review of plans, schematics, calculations, and specifications. The Infrastructure Engineer is required to effectively work with all involved parties, assess proposals, make recommendations, and determines comprehensive response to 3rd party requests. It includes working closely with, coordinating, and collaborating with all Qatar Rail departments, agencies/authorities, designers, and contractors internal and external to ensure conclusive and timely response. These responsibilities include attending meetings with various stakeholders.

* Provide infrastructure interface & coordination services (assistance, guidance) for the Qatar Rail schemes in relation to multiple interfaces with applicants, designers, utility agencies, contractors, stakeholders, etc.
* Review, assess, evaluate, and respond to third party requests, design-, engineering-, and construction- documents including plans, work method and specifications to ensure compliance with applicable requirements, codes, ordinances, and standards (NOC, MME, DR, RO, PTW, IPD, others); with sound understanding of utility works.
* Supporting the sr. engineer and manager as well as the relevant co-workers, departments in tasks related to approvals.
* Ensure & check completeness of documents and submissions as part of the NOC process.
* Provide and prepare interface drawings and relevant response documents.
* Participate in and create manuals, forms, procedures for processing stakeholder applications.
* Identify elements for optimizations and improvement of the department.
* Act as a link between PMC, D&B contractor and third parties.
* Attend and record meetings and act as contact person for local authorities.
* As required, inspect sites on a periodical basis to ensure conformance with permits, design specifications and adherence to quality. Provide site inspection reports.
* Resolve issues within level of authority and address modifications or changes.
* Plan, organize, track, control and evaluate the assigned functions and activities. Works proactively and responsibly.
* Maintain logs and records of work performed; prepares periodic and special reports.
* Monitor and track the TID correspondence (documentation of day-to-day work).
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**General:**

* Incorporate zero harm into staff yearly performance reviews by incorporating and taking into consideration, staff commitment to the Qatar Rail values of safety and environment.
* Commitment to the Zero Harm Ethos by leading by example and taking personal responsibility for their own health and safety and proactively ensuring that any health and safety concerns observed are raised to prevent harm.
* Support the QR Environmental program in reducing QR carbon footprint.
* Managers need to be familiar with relevant laws, regulations and standards that apply to their area of operation.
* Proactive identification of potential hazards/environmental aspects and implementing effective control measures to minimize risks.
* Liaise with HSE professionals from QSHESE Department on complex issues.
* Comply with Qatar Rail’s Company Management System requirements which covers Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, Information Security, Business continuity, Security and Emergency preparedness requiements.
* Attendance of any QSHESE Induction, training, briefing, or meeting as and when required and/or requested to.
* Be mindful that Health and Safety, Quality, Security and Environment is everyone’s responsibility and as such all-Qatar Rail employees are accountable for reporting and intervening in Health, Safety, Quality, Security and Environmental violations.
* Report all incidents and/or near misses, and/or unsafe acts or conditions and where appropriate make recommendations for improvement.
* Ensure your visitor (including contractors, PMCs) are aware of Qatar Rail premise’s emergency response plans.
* Act ethically and within Qatar Rail’s Code of Conduct.
* Undertake additional tasks as required based emerging business needs.

**Authorities:**

The position covers all interfaces through Technical Interface Department with the relevant authorities and governmental bodies. The main interface is related to authorities and stakeholders in relation to 3rd party management for the purpose of permitting within the Rail-Protection-Zone.

**Accountabilities:**

* Establishing clear line of communication with the relevant team members, departments, external stakeholders.
* Review and approve NOC-third party applications, for resign review (DR)- and road opening (RO), permit applications.
* Participate & prepare clear procedure(s) related to stakeholder management.
* Produce status- and progress reports.
* Participate in meetings, audits, presentations, workshops, and other events

**Key Interfaces:**

***Internal:***

* All Metro-, Tram lines and Long-Distance Railway.
* Departments within Program Delivery & Service Delivery
* Contractors & Joint Ventures & Consultants.
* RKH Qitarat (Service Provider)

***External:***

* Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Municipality, Public Works Authority, Civil Aviation Authority, Qatar Foundation, Private Engineering Office, Ministry of Interior (multiple departments), Supreme Committee for Delivery & Legacy, Qatar Olympic Committee, Qatar Ports Authority, Qatar Armed Forces, Hamad International Airport .
* Kahramaa Electricity & Water, Qatar Cool, Qatar Energy (Petroleum), Vodafone, QNBN, Ooredoo, MOI Police, other affected utility companies.
* Third party developers (governmental & private)
* Contractors & consultants
* Third party entities potentially affecting the Qatar Rail assets within the Rail Protection Zone.

 **Qualifications**

* Knowledge of permitting procedures, requirements, and public approvals.
* Knowledge in infrastructure planning, design, and construction of roads, bridges, drinking water, wastewater, storm drainage, irrigation, power transmission/distribution, and preferably gas-, oil pipelines, district cooling.
* Registered as professional engineer is desirable.
* Membership with professional bodies is desirable.

 **Additional Information**

* Advanced computer skills in Microsoft office including Word, Excel, Power Point and other computer programs.

* Experience with AutoCAD is desired.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Applicant to be fluent in English (verbal/written); Arabic language skills are beneficial.

**Soft Competencies:**

* Self-motivated team-player, capable of working independently & organized

* Communicate effectively with stakeholders, peers, and members of the public.

Title: Field Operation Management
Description:
**Grow with us**
**About this opportunity:**
The Regional Manager – Technical Building Management (TBM) is a pivotal leadership role responsible for overseeing end-to-end Operations and Maintenance (O&M) across all assigned stc technical buildings and mission-critical data centers. Leading regional field and monitoring teams, this role ensures 100% infrastructure uptime, strict SLA compliance, energy efficiency, and seamless stakeholder coordination with stc. The position requires deep expertise in critical facilities management, electromechanical systems, and enterprise maintenance workflows.
  
  
**What you will do:**
**Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Management**

* Preventive & Corrective Maintenance: Direct the monthly execution of Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules across all electromechanical assets, HVAC, power systems, civil infrastructure, janitorial/housekeeping services, and technical room cleaning in strict compliance with stc systems (IFSM).
* Seasonal & High-Profile Event Readiness: Plan and execute specialized maintenance operations and standby support for critical seasonal peaks and national events across the Kingdom, including Hajj, Ramadan, Saudi National Day, and Foundation Day, as well as major international sporting events, expos, conferences, and festivals.
* Site Rehabilitation & Commissioning: Supervise site rehabilitation works and actively participate in acceptance, testing, and commissioning activities.

Title: Data Validation & Quality Analyst
Description:
**Job Description**

**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

**AI Disclosure:** As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

  

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

  

The ideal candidate combines strong data quality and validation fundamentals with a focus on automation and continuous improvement. They are comfortable working closely with data engineering, business analysis, governance, and business stakeholders to define quality expectations, detect and resolve data issues, and ensure enterprise data is complete, accurate, consistent, and aligned with schema requirements across legacy and cloud environments.

  

**The Role**
------------

  

As a Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data, you will continuously monitor and assess the quality of data within the enterprise data warehouse. You will help ensure that data is complete, accurate, consistent, timely, and compliant with defined schema and business requirements.

  

This role focuses on designing, automating, and maintaining data validation and quality controls across data pipelines and warehouse environments. You will work closely with the Data Engineering team to embed checks into data workflows and with the Business Analyst to understand business rules, data definitions, and stakeholder expectations. You will investigate exceptions, coordinate issue resolution, and provide clear visibility into data quality and remediation status. The role supports both the existing legacy environment and its migration to a cloud-based implementation, which may be Azure/Databricks or Google Cloud Platform.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

* Develop, automate, and maintain data-quality checks to monitor completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, uniqueness, and timeliness across enterprise data.
* Define and implement schema validation controls to confirm that data structures, formats, data types, required fields, and constraints meet agreed requirements.
* Build automated validation into data ingestion, transformation, and publishing workflows in partnership with data engineers.
* Create repeatable checks for record counts, null values, duplicates, referential integrity, domain values, business rules, and cross-source reconciliation.
* Monitor data-quality results and pipeline outputs on an ongoing basis; identify anomalies, unexpected changes, and emerging quality trends.
* Establish alerting and exception-management processes so that data issues are detected, prioritized, communicated, and resolved promptly.
* Investigate data-quality incidents by tracing issues across source systems, transformations, schemas, and downstream consumers.
* Partner with data engineers to identify root causes, define corrective actions, and prevent recurring defects through improved controls and automation.
* Work with the Business Analyst and business stakeholders to translate business rules, data definitions, and quality expectations into clear, testable validation criteria.
* Support data migration and modernization by defining and executing validation and reconciliation plans for legacy-to-cloud data, including parallel-run comparisons where appropriate.
* Verify that migrated data conforms to target schemas, transformation logic, and agreed business rules while supporting continuity of existing data services.
* Maintain data-quality dashboards, scorecards, exception reports, and operational metrics that provide clear visibility into quality levels and remediation progress.
* Document validation rules, test results, defects, root causes, remediation actions, and quality standards.
* Support data governance practices by helping maintain data definitions, quality thresholds, ownership, lineage, and control documentation.
* Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, defect prioritization, demos, and continuous improvement with the data delivery team.
Participate in incident reviews and recommend improvements to validation coverage, monitoring, processes, and operational readiness.  

  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**
--------------------------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience in data quality, data validation, data analysis, quality assurance, data engineering, or a related field.
* Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing data in relational databases or enterprise data warehouse environments.
* Experience creating and executing data validation, reconciliation, and quality tests for production or business-critical data.
* Experience automating repetitive data checks using Python, SQL, or comparable scripting and programming tools.
* Understanding of relational data structures, schemas, data types, keys, constraints, and data integration concepts.
* Ability to translate business rules and data requirements into measurable and repeatable validation criteria.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to identify patterns, isolate root causes, and assess downstream impacts.
* Experience tracking data defects, documenting findings, coordinating resolution, and verifying corrective actions.
* Familiarity with data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes, including how data is ingested, transformed, and delivered to consumers.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple quality issues and priorities.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

  

* Experience supporting data quality in an enterprise data warehouse, especially in an Oracle-based environment.
* Experience supporting data warehouse modernization or migration to Azure, Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with data-quality automation frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, Deequ, dbt tests, or equivalent tools.
* Experience using Python libraries and automation patterns to build repeatable data testing and monitoring solutions.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Synapse, or equivalent cloud data and lakehouse platforms.
* Experience with data observability, anomaly detection, automated alerting, and data-quality dashboards.
* Familiarity with data governance concepts including data ownership, metadata, lineage, classification, and quality thresholds.
* Experience defining and monitoring data-quality metrics, scorecards, service targets, or operational controls.

Title: Process Coordinator
Description:
Role summary

The Process Coordinator leads AI-led process redesign. The role takes each business process cuts it down to the steps and fields that matter, gets the rules built into Zoho CRM, and replaces manual reports with live, AI-generated dashboards for each department and role.

The goal is simple: people put the right data in the right place at the right time, and AI turns it into decisions. Managers and coordinators should stop building reports and chasing updates by hand.

This is a process and data role, not a training role. The right person reads workflows and Zoho logic, thinks in fields and data, and is comfortable shortening a process and challenging a manager when a step adds no value.

Key responsibilities1. Process redesign

* Map each current process end to end from the CRM field list, the current SOP and how the team actually works.

* Cut steps and fields that do not feed a decision or a report.

* Set one owner and one time limit for every stage.

* Define the blocking rules the CRM must enforce (for example, no case closes without evidence; no paid job closes without an invoice number), each with a logged override.

* Link modules so data flows without re-entry (for example, case to invoice; confirmed deal to PRQ, PO and delivery).

* Write the one-page SOP for each process: stage, owner, time limit, what must exist before moving on, and what is automatic.

* Take each redesign to the department head and the fortnightly Signal review for approval; L&D then signs off the final SOP.

2. Live dashboards with AI tools

* Own the live dashboards produced through AI tools and Zoho Analytics.

* Assign department-specific and role-specific dashboards: what a sales coordinator, a manager, a division manager and a department head each need to see every day.

* Use the dashboards in real-time reviews and daily huddles so discussions run on live data, not on spreadsheets prepared the night before.

* Set up daily exception lists and weekly reports pulled automatically from the CRM and from source documents (SOPs, POs, invoices, PRQs), so nobody types the same data twice.

* Check data quality before trusting a dashboard: blocking rules come before dashboards, because AI on bad data gives confident wrong answers.

3. Less manual work

* Find every manual report, Excel tracker and repeated hand-off in each department and replace it with a dashboard or an automatic summary.

* Formally retire the old report the day the new dashboard goes live, so teams do not run both.

* Work with IT to clean up automatic tasks that a CRM rule can replace, and raise on-time completion of tasks.

* Track and report manual reporting hours removed.

4. Rollout and adoption

* Run the 8-step redesign cycle for each process: AI baseline audit, design, build, pilot, measure, fix, roll out, retire the old way.

* Write clear build requirements for IT (fields, module links, Blueprint rules, automations) and test them before go-live.

* Support DMs and department heads, who own adoption in their teams.

* Prepare and present at the fortnightly Signal review with senior leadership and IT: designs for approval, blockers and numbers against baseline.

Role requirements

* Can read a Zoho CRM module (fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflows) and explain what it does and where it breaks.

* Can take a field list and an SOP and produce a shorter, rule-based process on paper within a day.

* Uses AI tools daily for analysis, summaries and dashboards, and knows how to check their output.

* Comfortable telling a senior manager that a step or a report should go, and backing it with data.

* Measures improvement as numbers against a baseline, not opinions.

* Leads change across departments and holds a redesign under challenge from senior managers, with the Sponsor's backing.

* Fluent written and spoken English; Arabic or Hindi is a plus.

Education

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, Operations Management, Business Analytics or a related field.

Industry experience

* **4-6 years** in process improvement, business analysis, CRM operations or sales/service operations.

* At least **2 years hands-on with a CRM**, ideally Zoho CRM (Salesforce or Dynamics also acceptable).

* Experience in **B2B trading, industrial equipment, distribution or after-sales service**, preferably in the UAE or GCC.

* Has led at least one process redesign or CRM rollout from mapping to go-live, with measurable results.

* Experience building or running management dashboards that replaced manual reports.

**Required skills**

Technical

* Zoho CRM: modules, fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflow rules, reports

* Dashboards and BI: Zoho Analytics, Power BI or similar

* AI tools for analysis and reporting (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot), including pulling data from documents and CRM exports

* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (pivots, lookups, data cleaning)

* Process mapping (Visio, Lucidchart, Miro or BPMN tools)

* Basic understanding of automations and integrations (Deluge, APIs, Zapier) is a plus

Analytical

* Reads data and fields to find where a process breaks

* Builds a baseline and measures change against it

* Spots bad data and its root cause before it reaches a dashboard

* Turns findings into a short, clear decision for a manager

Behavioural

* Simplifier: removes steps instead of adding them

* Confident with senior managers; willing to challenge

* Structured and finishes what it starts: one process at a time, closed properly

* Clear writer: one-page SOPs, short build specs, plain reports

* Patient with teams during change; firm on the rules

Pay: AED3,000.00 - AED4,500.00 per month

Title: Senior Customer Service Supervisor – Complaints & Customer Experience
Description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Senior Customer Service Supervisor – Complaints & Customer Experience**

**Department:** Customer Service / Operations  
**Industry:** Car Rental – UAE  
**Reporting To:** Operations Head  
**Location:** UAE

**1. Job Purpose**

To oversee and manage all customer complaints, escalations, customer feedback, and online reviews across the company's car rental operations in the UAE.

The Senior Customer Service Supervisor will be responsible for ensuring that all customer concerns received through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, messages, social media platforms, and online review portals are properly investigated, addressed, and resolved within the defined turnaround time.

The role requires close coordination with the Operations Head and relevant departments to conduct fair case investigations, identify the root cause of complaints, prepare case studies, recommend corrective actions, and improve overall customer satisfaction and service standards.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Complaint Management & Resolution**

* Take ownership of all customer complaints and escalations received through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, SMS, social media, and other communication channels.
* Ensure every complaint is properly registered, categorized, assigned, tracked, and closed within the agreed turnaround time.
* Handle escalated customer cases professionally, ensuring timely communication and appropriate resolution.
* Investigate complaints related to vehicle condition, breakdowns, replacement delays, delivery and collection, billing, deposits, refunds, traffic fines, Salik, accident claims, insurance, rental agreements, and customer service.
* Ensure customers receive regular updates until their concerns are fully resolved.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to avoid delays and ensure accountability.

**B. Online Reviews & Reputation Management**

* Monitor and manage customer reviews across Google Reviews and other relevant online platforms.
* Respond professionally to positive and negative customer reviews within the defined response time.
* Investigate negative reviews and coordinate with the concerned departments to establish the facts before providing a response.
* Ensure no complaint or negative review remains unattended.
* Identify recurring negative feedback and recommend improvements to the Operations Head.
* Maintain a professional brand image and improve the company's online reputation.
* Follow up with customers after successful complaint resolution and encourage genuine customer feedback.

**C. Fair Case Investigation & Case Studies**

* Conduct a fair and unbiased investigation for every escalated complaint.
* Collect supporting documents, call recordings, WhatsApp conversations, emails, rental agreements, vehicle inspection reports, photographs, invoices, and system records wherever applicable.
* Prepare a detailed case study covering:
* Customer complaint and issue summary.
* Date and time of the incident.
* Background and rental agreement details.
* Investigation findings and supporting evidence.
* Department or process involved.
* Root cause of the complaint.
* Company's responsibility, where applicable.
* Proposed resolution and corrective action.
* Discuss all major and sensitive cases with the Operations Head before concluding the matter.
* Ensure resolutions are fair, transparent, and aligned with company policies, rental agreements, and applicable UAE regulations.
* Maintain proper documentation of the final decision and customer communication.

**D. Coordination with Operations & Other Departments**

* Work closely with the Operations Head, branch managers, fleet, workshop, dispatch, delivery and collection, finance, insurance, and sales teams.
* Obtain factual feedback from concerned departments before making commitments to customers.
* Escalate cases involving financial exposure, compensation, refunds, service failures, or reputational risks to the Operations Head.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented by the responsible departments.
* Follow up on pending actions until closure.
* Highlight operational gaps affecting customer satisfaction and recommend process improvements.

**E. Customer Communication & Service Standards**

* Ensure all customer interactions through incoming and outgoing calls, WhatsApp, emails, SMS, and online platforms are handled professionally.
* Establish consistent communication standards for the customer service team.
* Ensure customers are treated respectfully, irrespective of the nature of their complaints.
* Monitor the quality of responses and ensure accurate information is communicated.
* Handle difficult customers and high-priority escalations with professionalism.
* Ensure no incorrect commitments, unauthorized compensation, or policy deviations are communicated to customers.

**F. Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly complaint reports.
* Maintain a complaint tracker with status, responsible department, aging, resolution, and closure remarks.
* Monitor complaint turnaround time and unresolved cases.
* Prepare monthly analysis of online ratings, negative reviews, complaint categories, and recurring issues.
* Identify departments with repeated service failures and highlight them to the Operations Head.
* Present improvement recommendations based on customer feedback and case investigation findings.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Performance Expectation**

Complaint acknowledgement

Within 15–30 minutes during working hours

Initial investigation

Within 24 hours

Complaint resolution

Target 90% within agreed TAT

Online review response

100% within 24 hours

Critical complaint escalation

Immediate escalation

Case study preparation

100% for major and escalated cases

Customer follow-up

100% for resolved escalated cases

Complaint documentation

100% accurate and updated

Recurring complaint analysis

Monthly

Customer satisfaction

Continuous improvement in customer feedback

Pending complaint monitoring

Daily follow-up with concerned departments

**4. Authority & Escalation Matrix**

* Responsible for managing and investigating all customer complaints.
* Authorized to coordinate directly with all departments for information and resolution.
* Responsible for recommending goodwill gestures, compensation, and service recovery, subject to approval.
* Must obtain Operations Head approval before committing to financial compensation, exceptional refunds, or policy deviations.
* Must escalate serious customer disputes, legal notices, regulatory matters, safety-related complaints, and high-risk online reviews immediately.
* Responsible for presenting major case studies and obtaining management direction before closing sensitive cases.

**5. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in customer service or complaint management, preferably in the UAE car rental, automotive, or hospitality industry.
* Strong understanding of UAE car rental operations, rental agreements, insurance, deposits, refunds, fines, Salik, vehicle delivery, and customer service procedures.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Knowledge of Arabic, Hindi, or other commonly used languages in the UAE is an advantage.
* Strong complaint-handling, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to investigate cases objectively and prepare detailed reports.
* Experience managing Google Reviews and social media customer feedback.
* Good knowledge of CRM systems, Microsoft Excel, and customer service reporting.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and manage escalations independently.

**6. Overall Accountability**

The Senior Customer Service Supervisor will be accountable for ensuring that every customer complaint receives proper attention, investigation, and a fair resolution.

The position is not limited to responding to customers or managing online reviews. It requires taking ownership of the complete complaint lifecycle, identifying operational failures, conducting fair case studies, coordinating with the Operations Head, and ensuring that corrective actions are implemented to prevent similar issues from recurring.

**The ultimate objective is to protect the company's reputation, improve customer satisfaction, reduce recurring complaints, and establish accountability across all operational departments.**

Title: Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)
Description:
**Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)**

**Platform & Reliability Engineering**

Location:
**Dubai, UAE**
|Function:
**Engineering**
| Type:
**Full-Time**
| Experience:
**7–10 years**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

*This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.*

**ABOUT THE FUNCTION**

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI-first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure-as-code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

**Core ownership:**
Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data-store operations, on-call & incident management, platform migration

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

* Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor-managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
* Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps-based delivery
* Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
* Build an open-source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
* Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
* Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue-green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
* Codify everything as infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
* Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
* Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
* Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Scope & Impact**

* Own multi-quarter, multi-team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
* Make independent technical decisions on open-ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self-hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
* Drive cross-team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team

**Technical Craft**

* Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
* Debug non-deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
* Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
* Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end-of-life runtimes
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Build the DevOps & SRE function: define its charter, roadmap and operating model, and how it works with product squads (platform-as-a-product, paved roads, self-service)
* Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
* Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
* Design a sustainable on-call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
* Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production-readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
* Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
* Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
* Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These are non-negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

* 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
* Expert-level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
* Strong infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
* Set up end-to-end observability and monitoring from scratch using open-source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self-hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on-call integration that teams rely on
* Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom-based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
* CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue-green
* Strong Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, CDN, load balancers) and scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash — able to read and debug Python/Django application code
* Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e-commerce, retail or other high-traffic consumer platforms

**NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

* Hands-on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self-managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback
* Proven experience migrating stateful systems with minimal downtime: PostgreSQL (logical replication, CDC), Kafka (MirrorMaker 2), Elasticsearch (snapshot/restore, reindexing) and Redis
* Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi), PostgreSQL operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Patroni) and the Elastic operator (ECK)
* Long-term metrics storage and scale-out observability: Thanos, Mimir or VictoriaMetrics; continuous profiling with Pyroscope; self-hosted Sentry
* Platform security and supply chain: HashiCorp Vault or External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper, Falco, image signing and SBOMs
* Chaos engineering and load testing with LitmusChaos or Chaos Mesh, and k6 or Locust
* Cost tooling and FinOps practice: OpenCost or Kubecost, rightsizing, committed-use and spot strategies
* Building an internal developer platform or portal (e.g. Backstage) for service templates and self-service environments
* Familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Pub/Sub) and supporting data-platform workloads
* Certifications such as CKA/CKS, Google Professional Cloud Architect or DevOps Engineer, or AWS DevOps Professional
* Public contributions: conference talks, technical blog posts or open-source maintainership

**TECH STACK**

**Application stack**

Python 3.9–3.12 (Django, DRF), Celery, Next.js / React, React Native

**Data stores**

PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

**Messaging**

Kafka

**Cloud**

GCP (GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) — target for platform migration; AWS / Azure exposure valued

**Containers**

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD

**IaC**

Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible

**CI/CD**

Bitbucket Pipelines

**Observability**

Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Sentry

**Security**

Vault / External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno, WAF

**Reliability**

SLOs & error budgets, k6, Chaos Mesh, OpenCost

**OUR VALUES**

At Lulu, our values aren't wall decorations — they guide how we work, hire, and grow.

**Be Customer Obsessed —**
Every decision in service of the customer's success.

**Speak & Act Courageously —**
Challenge the status quo, take calculated risks, and advocate for new ideas.

**Take Extreme Ownership —**
Nothing is someone else's problem. Uphold excellence and accountability.

**Learn Voraciously —**
Growth mindset, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Move with Focus & Urgency —**
Identify the highest-impact work and move fast.

**Win as One Team —**
Celebrate wins, lend a hand, and invest in each other's growth.

*We believe great engineering is about judgment, ownership, and craft — not just code.*

*If that resonates, we would love to hear from you.*

Title: Recruitment and Outreach Advisor
Description:
**Recruitment and Outreach Advisor**

**Status:** Full Time

**Hours:** Monday – Friday, 35 hours/week

**Home Campus:** Fennell (hybrid work arrangements available)

**Rate of Pay:** Payband J (Start Rate: $44.48 per hour)

**Vacancy Status:** 1 vacancy available

**Posting Date:** November 16th, 2026

**Closing Date:** November 20th, 2026 at 7:00 pm EST

Preference will be given to qualified employees within the Full Time Support Staff bargaining unit, Appendix D (6 consecutive months in Appendix D status) and RPT employees who have passed probation at Mohawk College.

We believe the rich diversity among our students and the communities we serve should be reflected within our workforce. As educators, we believe it is important to act and show leadership in advancing the principles of reconciliation, equity, diversity, and inclusion in our community.

Reporting to the Manager, Student Recruitment and in support of the college’s strategic enrolment objectives, the Recruitment & Outreach Advisor plays a key role in the execution of the college’s student recruitment and conversion strategy. This involves executing tactics that positively influence each learner's decision to choose Mohawk College.

A foundational aspect of this role is the development and nurturing of relationships with partners across the college community and communities served, including prospective students, parents, teachers, guidance counsellors, and community and industry partners, such as employers in the Premium Employer Program and members of Mohawk's alumni network.

Please note that the Recruitment and Outreach Advisor position requires a valid G driver's license in good standing and the use of a personal vehicle. The role involves extensive travel within a 1- to 2-hour radius of the college, with mileage reimbursed in accordance with college policy. The position also requires occasional overnight travel, ranging from one night to up to a week at a time.

**What you’ll be doing:**

**Recruitment and Advising Activities**

* Engages direct and non-direct prospects and applicants through the delivery of dynamic outreach strategies such as targeted email campaigns, collaboration with high school, college, community agencies and industry partners around events and visits that support the college’s enrolment goals.
* Initiates, builds and cultivates relationships with prospective students, applicants, parents/guardians, PSE Administrators, guidance counsellors, teachers, department heads, administrators, industry partners, and internal college partners.
* **Outreach:** Proactively identifies individuals and groups who are encountering challenges in navigating the enrolment process. They conduct assessments with individuals, schools, or community groups and execute outreach efforts, including in-person events and online engagement, to provide support and intervention where needed.
* **Advising:** Possesses knowledge across various aspects of Mohawk, including programs, pathways, career options, student expectations, and the enrolment process. This knowledge is utilized to advise and encourage prospective, previously enrolled who wish to return, and current applicants in need of guidance through to enrolling. These activities encompass 1:1 or group advising (both in person and digitally), proactive outreach via phone or email to individuals identified as requiring additional support, and participation in presentations and panels.
* **Identifies Recruitment Opportunities:** Identifies opportunities for outreach or events to support enrolment objectives. Coordination and delivery of school/site visits, parent/information nights, information session, as well as at other education and career fairs.
* **Collaboration and Liaison:** Plays a key role in the new student continuum, sharing information related to various services available to support new students, including but not limited to admissions, financial services, the career centre and various others, facilitating the introduction and warm handoff of the client to such services, ensuring a seamless and relational experience between the client and the institution.
* **Information Management:** Recording all interactions, including 1:1 advising, site visits, organization profiles, all events, notes and correspondence with prospects to the college. Recording data in a customized CRM software, creating personal dashboards, advanced finds (reports), to track all activity, and to provide follow-up to applicants to the college.
* **Access & Transition Support:** Through 1:1 advising, completing an intake, and needs assessment, the incumbent will offer options/choices and resources that assist potential applicants in overcoming identified barriers. Referrals to other services, like Accessible Learning Services, or Financial Assistance, including any interactions needed, through to registration.
* **Relationship Building:** With prospective applicants, and key partners, within their portfolios, the incumbent works to identify needs, to respond to and accommodate requests, to provide resources and superior customer service experiences, that encourages repeat interactions with the college to make Mohawk a sought-after destination.

**Marketing & Communications**

* **Multi-Media Presentations:** Creating & delivering presentations to promote college programs and services to prospective applicants, in an accurate and interactive way, using PowerPoint, videos and guest speakers, webinars, Facebook Live! events.
* **Strategic Outreach Campaigns:** Builds and maintains relationships with schools and community organizations, using a combination of personal visits, telephone calls, email, e-blast messages, social media, posters, and educator resource packages.
* **Feedback:** Listening to applicants and other community partners, and provide input and feedback on promotional pieces (flyers, posters, correspondence) to be used for site visits, presentations, educational fairs, workshops and campus tours; also provides feedback to the College Marketing team, on major college initiatives and products like the Full-time Calendar.
* **Campus Tours:** Coordinate tours for high schools, students and community groups.

**CRM & Data Management**

* **Enrolment/Status Reports:** Regularly review and retain knowledge of current program status – i.e., enrolment numbers, waitlists, new programs, terms, changes in admissions requirements etc.
* **OCAS data:** Review of historical data to plan annual recruitment campaign and to determine return visits and appropriate levels of interaction.
* **Events/Activities:** Ensure that information tracked in a custom CRM is accurate and available to recruiting and marketing partners for the purpose of regular reporting to the CMO and VP SS, and to support on-going marketing initiatives and promotional uses.
* **CRM:** Using a client-engagement approach, all prospects are closely tracked and monitored in a customized CRM that records demographics, notes, program applications and 1:1 meetings, with additional supports/resources offered, educational partners and related activity is also tracked using this approach. Incumbent is responsible for accurate use of the system, to participate in training, and to highlight issues and opportunities to the system administrator.
* **Reporting:** Accuratemonthly recording and reporting of all prospects, recruitment events and activities, measuring response rates, participation, success stories, and photos for future in publications, SLT, MEG and Board of Governor purposes.

Title: Utilization Review
Description:
Position Summary

The Utilization Review (UR) Specialist manages the authorization lifecycle for patients receiving behavioral health and substance use disorder (SUD) treatment across MYMB's client facilities. This role secures initial authorizations, completes concurrent reviews, and advocates for medically necessary levels of care with commercial payers, managed care organizations, and government plans. The UR Specialist works closely with facility clinical teams, admissions, VOB, billing, and appeals to protect reimbursement and keep patients in the care they need.

Levels of Care Supported

* Medical detoxification / withdrawal management
* Residential treatment
* Inpatient psychiatric hospitalization
* Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
* Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
* Outpatient (OP) and psychiatric services
* Adolescent residential / academy programs

Essential Duties and Responsibilities Authorizations and Reviews

* Obtain pre-certification and initial authorizations for admissions, typically within 24–72 hours of admit or per payer requirements
* Conduct concurrent (continued-stay) reviews by phone, portal, or fax, presenting clinical information clearly and persuasively to payer care managers
* Request step-down authorizations as patients transition between levels of care (e.g., detox → residential → PHP → IOP)
* Track authorization numbers, approved dates/units, next review dates, and LOC changes in the EMR and UR tracking log
* Complete retrospective reviews when authorization was not obtained at admission

Clinical Documentation and Medical Necessity

* Review clinical records (assessments, psychiatric evaluations, nursing notes, progress notes, treatment plans, discharge plans) to build a strong medical necessity case
* Apply ASAM Criteria, InterQual, MCG, LOCUS/CALOCUS, and payer-specific guidelines to justify level of care
* Identify documentation gaps and communicate them promptly to clinical staff so records support the requested care
* Coordinate with facility physicians for peer-to-peer reviews and prepare case summaries in advance

Denials, Appeals, and Payer Communication

* Respond to adverse determinations by scheduling peer-to-peer reviews and initiating expedited or standard appeals within payer timelines
* Draft or assist with written UR appeal letters, and hand off post-service appeals to the Appeals team with complete documentation
* Maintain professional working relationships with payer UR representatives and case managers
* Escalate trends in denials, short authorizations, or payer behavior to UR leadership

Coordination and Reporting

* Communicate daily authorization status, last covered days (LCDs), and pending reviews to facility clinical directors, admissions, and billing
* Partner with VOB to confirm benefits, UR requirements, and payer contacts prior to admission
* Ensure authorization data matches claims to prevent billing denials
* Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly UR reports (census, auth status, denials, days approved vs. requested)
* Update UR task lists, spreadsheets, and EMR records (e.g., KIPU) accurately and on time

Compliance

* Maintain strict confidentiality under HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 (SUD records)
* Follow payer contracts, state regulations, and company policies on authorization and documentation
* Participate in audits and quality reviews as requested

Qualifications

* 2+ years of utilization review experience in behavioral health and/or substance use disorder treatment
* Working knowledge of ASAM Criteria and medical necessity standards for psychiatric and SUD levels of care
* Experience with commercial payers (e.g., BCBS/Anthem, Aetna, Cigna, UHC/Optum, Humana) and managed behavioral health organizations
* Strong clinical vocabulary: DSM-5 diagnoses, withdrawal symptoms/scales (CIWA, COWS), risk factors, and treatment interventions
* Excellent verbal advocacy and written communication skills
* Ability to manage a high-volume caseload across multiple facilities with competing deadlines
* Proficiency with EMRs, payer portals, Microsoft Excel/Outlook

Preferred

* Licensed clinician or clinical background (LPN, RN, LCSW, LPC, LMFT, CADC, CAC, or similar)
* Experience with KIPU, or comparable EMR/PM systems
* InterQual or MCG certification
* Experience with adolescent and inpatient psychiatric UR
* Familiarity with out-of-network billing, single case agreements, and payer appeals

Description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Toronto, Ontario (CA-ON), Canada (CA).
  
Job Description
  
  
Job Title
  
  
Technical Architect – Oracle Analytics, Middleware EBS
  
  
**Company:** NTT DATA
  
**Delivery Model:** Offshore
  
**Tower:** Application Infrastructure Services
  
**Capability:** Oracle Analytics Middleware
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
  
**Experience Required:** 10+ Years
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking an experienced Technical Architect – Oracle Analytics, Middleware EBS to provide technical leadership and hands-on production support for enterprise Oracle Analytics environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a senior technical SME responsible for the architecture, administration, availability, performance, security, patching, modernization, and operational support of Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE/OBI), Oracle Fusion Middleware, WebLogic, Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and Linux-hosted Oracle analytics platforms.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical architecture role requiring the ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex production issues spanning the analytics, middleware, operating system, database, identity, security, and application layers.
  
  
The Technical Architect will also provide leadership for platform modernization, OBIEE-to-OAS migrations, major upgrades, patching, performance optimization, automation, disaster recovery, and environment lifecycle management.

Oracle Analytics – OAS OBIEE

Administer and troubleshoot Oracle Analytics services, configurations, repositories, catalogs, agents, scheduled jobs, caches, and usage tracking.
  
  
Monitor and troubleshoot report execution, dashboards, analytics services, and platform components.
  
  
Perform detailed log analysis and correlation across Oracle Analytics and associated middleware components.
  
  
Diagnose platform outages and execute appropriate service-restoration and recovery procedures.
  
  
Manage analytics repositories, catalogs, BAR files, RPDs, deployments, and environment-specific configurations.
  
  
Troubleshoot complex report, dashboard, semantic-model, repository, and data-access issues.
  
  
Monitor platform health, capacity, availability, and performance.
  
  
Provide technical guidance for analytics platform upgrades, modernization, migrations, and decommissioning.
  
  
Oracle Fusion Middleware WebLogic

Manage WebLogic domains, Administration Servers, Managed Servers, Node Manager, clusters, and associated services.
  
  
Troubleshoot middleware startup, shutdown, communication, deployment, performance, and availability issues.
  
  
Manage RCU schemas, service accounts, credentials, and associated platform dependencies.
  
  
Configure and troubleshoot JDBC data sources, connection pools, database drivers, network ports, and aliases.
  
  
Support WebLogic domain configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle-management activities.
  
  
Analyze WebLogic and Fusion Middleware logs to identify and remediate complex production issues.
  
  
Oracle E-Business Suite Integration Support

Understand and troubleshoot Oracle EBS architecture, including application tiers, concurrent processing, database connectivity, interfaces, responsibilities, and access.
  
  
Support scheduled EBS processes and reporting integrations.
  
  
Diagnose failures involving Oracle EBS-dependent reports, interfaces, scheduled processes, or output delivery.
  
  
Collaborate with EBS application, database, middleware, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-platform issues.

WebLogic

Title: Claims Officer
Description:
**\*\*\*PREFERENCE WILL BE GIVEN TO QATARI CANDIDATES\*\*\***
-------------------------------------------------------------

**Reporting structure**
-----------------------

**Reports to:** Head of Chartering

**Direct Reportees:** None

**Location:** Doha

**Job Summary and Purpose**
---------------------------

Monitor and timely process claims related to Nakilat’s commercially managed fleet, collaborate and align with all related stakeholders internally to get the best possible outcomes via the charterparty terms and/or support in negotiations with the relevant counterparties.

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels in line with charter party warranties and generate a monthly summary report highlighting any areas of over/underperformance (actual and potential). Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.
* Recommend actions to resolve performance issues and continuously work towards the performance and efficiency of the fleet of ships.
* Monitor, track, and execute relevant cost reimbursement claims to charterers while liaising with the relevant internal stakeholders, i.e. Insurance, Finance, Fleet, etc.
* Provide relevant documents and information to successfully address any audit (internal and/or external) requirements.
* Support chartering & post fixture activities by ensuring compliance with charter party terms.
* Ensure compliance with proper procedures regarding management and approval of claims with reference to the respective and relevant internal lines of approval.
* Monitor and track the Charterers’ accounts, in collaboration with Finance, from a financial perspective to highlight any areas of concern where transactions would need attention. i.e. Hire, claims, cost reimbursement, etc.
* Facilitate regular meetings with Charterers for business discussions on the topic of claims, as required.

**Key Accountabilities 2**
--------------------------

**Legal and Insurance:**

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

**Planning:**

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.
* Support the team in coordinating the periodical meetings with vessels’ technical manager to address any technical/operational issues which could have a commercial impact as well as address any customers’ concerns.
* Support the team in coordinating timely between Charterers and vessels’ technical manager to conduct any Owners’ related matters (e.g., SIRE, Crew change, spares delivery, lube oil supply) with minimum deviation and minimum (target zero) off hire & claim avoidance.

**Generic Accountabilities**
----------------------------

**Quality, Health, Safety, & Environment (QHSE):**

* Adhere to all relevant SHEQ policies, procedures, instructions, and controls so that NAKILAT provides a safe, world class, secure and environmentally responsible service to customers, the public and its own people.
* Track EUETS reports, procure EUAs and seek re-imbursement from charterers.
* Track Fuel EU compliance balance and other environmental regulations related to commercial settlement with charterers.

**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures:**

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.
* Recommend updates for the division’s relevant P&Ps for claims, as deemed appropriate to cope with evolving business needs.

**Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills**
---------------------------------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Business/Economics/Technical of Marine Engineering or any other relevant field.
* Diploma in ship management and operations (ICS preferred).
* Diploma in ship chartering (ICS preferred).

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience as a charterer, shipping and commercial operator in a ship-owning company, chartering desk, trading desk, International Oil & Gas Company, or brokerage house.
* Ideally most recent position should involve commercial and post-fixture operations of vessels preferably LNGCs, VLGCs or tankers.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* Experience in contracts and claims negotiation will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of Shipping Commercial management – Chartering and Post-fixture Operations.
* Good record of leading and managing claims negotiations and minimizing commercial exposure.
